about_the_game:
Mirai's Midnight Stream — Official Artbook

Step into the captivating world of Kanou Mirai, the two-tailed fox spirit, with this exquisite artbook featuring stunning CGs and detailed concept designs!

Features:

Character Design: Discover how the two-tailed fox spirit was created, and explore how Kanou Mirai's beauty and charm was brought to life.

Outfit Design: 15 carefully crafted outfit designs of various styles, each showcasing a different side of our favorite foxy fox spirit.

Stream CGs: The official artbook contains all 55 stream scenes—relive all the highlights from themes such as outdoor sex, maid play, nipple training, anal development, and BDSM.

Discipline CGs: Enhance the fox spirit's allure and sensuality by exploring various intimate positions—rediscover the joy of her sexual journey.

Event CGs: Captures the best moments from in-game events and the story that moved us all. Experience once more the bond of love that grows between the protagonist and the fox spirit.

Ending CGs: Beautiful illustrations of all 15 unique endings, each telling a different version of your shared destiny.

Prequel Manga: Dive into a bonus manga that unveils Kanou Mirai's mysterious past, thereby deepening your understanding of her emotional, spiritual, and mental transformation.

Packed with exclusive content, the official artbook for Mirai's Midnight Stream offers a complete visual experience of the fox spirit's world. If you're a connoisseur of adult entertainment seeking to savor every carefully crafted detail of the game and indulge in Kanou Mirai's tender charms, then this artbook is for you.
